netMultiplierScope.note: Every catalogued item carries priceBasis "list", so NET = list x netMultiplier for all four sections. Freight is quoted already net by the shipping schedule and is never multiplied. The dealer confirmed on 2026-09-10, from ordering, that the 48% applies to components, prehang adders and hardware as well as to doors. Hoelscher put it in writing on the price sheet itself, seen 2026-09-11, so vendorConfirmed is now true.
netMultiplierScope.vendorConfirmedSource: Hoelscher Dealer Wood Pricing, page 1 of 7, effective 7-1-2026: "Use a 0.48 multiplier for NET cost" printed in the sheet header.

freight.source: Hoelscher Weatherstrip delivery charges, San Antonio / Austin zone
freight.note: Two separate charges. $100 net per prehung OPENING (a single door with sidelites and a transom is one opening), plus a crate & shipping charge chosen by the total unit count of the whole order. Both are quoted net and are never multiplied by netMultiplier.

openingSpec.note: Handing and swing are recorded on the quote for the order. Neither Hoelscher price sheet prices them, so neither changes the price.

jambDepths.note: Both lines catalogue a jamb at each depth (fiberglass PVC Jamb, wood Exterior Jamb Leg). The dealer confirmed on 2026-09-10 that a Hoelscher prehung price includes the jamb at either depth, so the depth is recorded on the quote and no charge is applied. Hoelscher has not put it in writing, so vendorConfirmed stays false.
